purpose: Source-selection and provenance policy; not a blanket rights clearance or a scraper.

verification.basis: Existing project asset policy/attribution plus source-specific acquisition rules. No new reference research or new source asset acquisition was performed for this registry.

global_rules: Prefer existing verified real assets and authored explanation before acquiring or generating new media.
A factual source and an asset-use source answer different questions; record both when relevant.
Unknown creator, date, license or access is explicit unknown; never fabricate.
Store original bytes unchanged and SHA256 before treatments; derivatives retain the source/operation chain.
Do not read a source-class entry as a license. A selected asset needs item-specific rights evidence.
Record generated media as ai_generated / generated supporting media; authored code graphics as motion_graphic; neither is historical evidence.
For each meaningful visual event decide whether sound helps; NONE is normal. A cached sound still requires provenance.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.preferred_usage: Original archival photographs, documents, maps and accurately identified historical objects.
sources.rights_caveat: A Commons host or public download is not a blanket grant. Read the exact file page, underlying-work and reproduction rights, attribution and ShareAlike terms separately; preserve all applicable notices.
sources.auth_login_info: Public item discovery is generally accessible; downloads or API limits can vary. No credentials configured by this registry.
sources.search_notes: Search original title, date, creator and institution; follow the File page back to the primary archive. Prefer the original-resolution file; do not use a search-result thumbnail as provenance.

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.preferred_usage: Digitized books, period documents and moving-image collections with item-level rights evidence.
sources.rights_caveat: Uploader metadata or collection membership alone does not establish permission. Distinguish public-domain scans, licensed uploads and restricted/borrowable works; record missing or ambiguous rights instead of assuming reuse.
sources.auth_login_info: Access and download/loan requirements vary by item. Login/borrowing availability does not grant reuse permission.
sources.search_notes: Find the exact edition/year and identifier; retain page/leaf or timecode. Confirm whether a scan actually contains the passage being illustrated.

sources.name: Library of Congress
sources.preferred_usage: Institutional photographs, maps, prints and film records with catalog metadata.
sources.rights_caveat: Use the item's Rights and Access statement. Institution hosting does not guarantee unrestricted reuse; third-party rights, restrictions and advisory notes may apply.
sources.auth_login_info: Public catalogs are browseable; individual media access or reproduction services vary. No account/permission is presumed.
sources.search_notes: Search named collection plus place/date/object. Record call number, digital ID, edition, page or timecode and link to the catalog record.

sources.name: Europeana
sources.preferred_usage: Discovery of European cultural-heritage objects with links to the holding institution.
sources.rights_caveat: A metadata reuse policy is not the media license. Preserve the digital object's rights label and verify it at the contributing institution; do not treat 'no known restrictions' as a universal grant.
sources.auth_login_info: Public discovery; original media access and login requirements belong to the contributing institution.
sources.search_notes: Follow the institution link for highest-resolution media and authoritative catalog data. Confirm dates and rights on the object rather than the result card.

sources.name: Flickr Commons
sources.preferred_usage: Institution-uploaded historical photographs with a recoverable archive chain.
sources.rights_caveat: 'No known copyright restrictions' is a contextual rights statement, not a warranty or an automatic CC license. Read the member institution's statement and item notes; ordinary Flickr uploads are separate.
sources.auth_login_info: Viewing/download availability can depend on host/account settings. No login or institutional reuse permission is assumed.
sources.search_notes: Verify the account is the participating institution; capture photograph identifier and original catalog link. Exclude repost accounts and unrelated same-name accounts.

sources.name: Official archives
sources.preferred_usage: Primary records from identifiable national, municipal, museum or library archives, such as an already documented Gallica record.
sources.rights_caveat: This is a source class, not one license. Inspect each institution/item's rights, digitization/reproduction terms and restrictions; keep underlying work and reproduction permissions distinct.
sources.auth_login_info: Per-institution access; use authorized public access or an already entitled account. Do not bypass restrictions.
sources.search_notes: Record the institution's real canonical URL before acquisition. Search catalog identifiers, original-language descriptions and exact period; never invent an archive URL.

sources.name: Company heritage archives
sources.preferred_usage: Corporate archives for product/brand chronology, original brochures and identified historical materials.
sources.rights_caveat: Ownership of the website or history does not grant media reuse. A factual citation and a visual-use permission are separate; record item/press-use terms or permission and avoid implied endorsement.
sources.auth_login_info: Public history pages, request-only archives or account-gated media may differ. No permission or paid access is presumed.
sources.search_notes: Prefer original dated documents and item metadata. Cross-check brand claims against existing factual research and retain source/marketing perspective; never substitute generated media for evidence.

sources.name: Pexels
sources.preferred_usage: Contemporary generic environmental footage when it illustrates a concept rather than a historical claim.
sources.rights_caveat: Check the asset page and current applicable license at acquisition; do not imply model, property or trademark clearance, endorsement or historical authenticity. Standalone redistribution and other restrictions require separate review.
sources.auth_login_info: Download/account behavior may vary; no account assumed. Capture any required license/author record from authorized access.
sources.search_notes: Search literal modern action/material/context. Mark contemporary stock and do not use it as an event-specific or period-specific record.

sources.name: Pixabay — visuals
sources.preferred_usage: Modern generic photos and footage with documented item provenance.
sources.rights_caveat: Check item and current content-license conditions at acquisition, including any additional third-party rights or restrictions. Platform availability is not a grant for every possible use.
sources.auth_login_info: Some downloads or quality tiers may require login. Use authorized access; no subscription or account is presumed.
sources.search_notes: Keep visual item page, creator and download identifier; avoid mistaking sponsored/external result cards for a Pixabay asset.

sources.name: Official press kits
sources.preferred_usage: Current product, venue or organization visuals accurately identified for editorial explanation.
sources.rights_caveat: A public press kit may be restricted to press/editorial use, approved context or specified attribution. Record exact terms and any embargo; do not assume advertising/commercial permission.
sources.auth_login_info: Use the official rights holder's verified press domain. Login/contact/approval may be required per kit; do not invent access.
sources.search_notes: Record canonical organization, kit version/date, item filename and permitted use. Search official newsroom/press pages and retain the accompanying terms.

sources.name: Mixkit — SFX
sources.preferred_usage: A specific short sound motivated by a visual event when narration benefits from it.
sources.rights_caveat: Review the selected sound's applicable license and restrictions at acquisition; licenses can differ by asset category. Never infer SFX rights from a video/music license or cache presence alone.
sources.auth_login_info: Public discovery; actual download availability may vary. No paid account or license is presumed.
sources.search_notes: Search by acoustic function and action, audition the exact file, log source page and trim/gain edits. No arbitrary mandatory shortlist; NONE is allowed.

sources.name: Pixabay — SFX
sources.preferred_usage: Scene-driven effects with recoverable creator, item and license evidence.
sources.rights_caveat: Check the exact sound's license and notices; preserve any download/license certificate. Do not assume cache presence removes rights requirements or guarantees no automated content claim.
sources.auth_login_info: Some download/certificate flows may require a logged-in account. Record actual authorized access; do not bypass it.
sources.search_notes: Search the intended acoustic action, inspect uploader/license record, audition in the narration mix and retain item ID. NONE is valid if the event gains nothing.

sources.name: Envato — authorized SFX
sources.preferred_usage: Sound effects only when an authorized account and an applicable project license record exist.
sources.rights_caveat: Do not use a preview, a subscription claim, or someone else's account as permission. Verify the actual item's applicable license and project registration/download evidence; preserve the terms and attribution requirements.
sources.auth_login_info: Requires verified authorized access and any applicable license/project registration. This registry does not establish an entitlement or authorize a purchase.
sources.search_notes: Choose exact event-appropriate audio. Record item ID, author, license certificate/project linkage and source; if access or rights cannot be established choose another source or NONE.

sources.name: Higgsfield
sources.preferred_usage: At most one short generated supporting asset for this benchmark, only after a concrete gap and expected benefit are recorded.
sources.rights_caveat: Generated output is not historical evidence or a blanket clearance of trademarks, likenesses or references. Preserve provider/model/request provenance and applicable output-use terms; classify as generated supporting media.
sources.auth_login_info: Official Codex Higgsfield connector only. Account access was read-only verified on 2026-10-10; model-specific generation, uploads, costs and output quality remain untested in this audit.
sources.search_notes: Use the decision and ingest contract in engine/integrations/higgsfield/. No new reference research for this phase, no unsupported custom API, no generation solely to demonstrate availability.

football_addendum.scope: episode-bosman planning and future football source selection only; existing Michelin scope and records remain unchanged

source_classes.preferred_usage: Actual C-415/93 judgment and faithful contextual excerpts
source_classes.rights_caveat: Judicial-document reuse is separate from site logos and third-party content; preserve source and meaning.

source_classes.preferred_usage: Accurately dated real institutional media only when exact rights permit
source_classes.rights_caveat: CURIA general Media Centre photo permission requires entire/unmodified image; building images may require third-party architectural permission. Never assume cropped building media is cleared.

source_classes.preferred_usage: Correct player, club, place and period with exact item license
source_classes.rights_caveat: Verify person identity and original upload/photographer; CC/PD territory and adaptation terms, event access and third-party rights separately. Commons host alone is not license. Contemporary stadium architecture and venue/access rules require separate review; photographer CC permission alone does not clear them.

source_classes.preferred_usage: Period player/event photograph with explicit purchased or granted video scope
source_classes.rights_caveat: Editorial label and preview availability are not permission. Capture rights holder, asset ID, usage scope, term, territory, platforms, transformations, credit and promotion/thumbnail rules.

source_classes.preferred_usage: Authentic club heritage/press assets and small supporting crests only with applicable rights
source_classes.rights_caveat: Official club webpage or style guide does not confer production reuse. Verify historic crest edition, photographer rights and no implied endorsement; plain names are fallback.

source_classes.preferred_usage: Public-domain geography underlying original authored football maps
source_classes.rights_caveat: Record exact dataset/version. Validate city coordinates and period membership separately. No Google Maps tiles/UI are inherited.

source_classes.preferred_usage: Exceptional licensed clip only; not default
source_classes.rights_caveat: UEFA example is not universal policy for other leagues. League/federation/broadcaster/club rights must cover exact clip, platforms, territory, term and intended reuse; social availability does not grant rights.

football_addendum.future_match_story_note: Without broadcast: authored pitch, score/clock and fact-checked movement paths with licensed real cutouts/photos/documents; indicate reconstruction where relevant. No fake live-match footage. No channel visual identity locked.
